name: run-watcher
description: Watches training logs, local or over ssh, in a pane: loss sparkline, and alerts when the loss goes NaN or spikes, a run crashes, or its output stalls

pollSeconds.title: Local poll interval
pollSeconds.description: Seconds between reads of local logs (at least 5)

remotePollSeconds.title: Remote poll interval
remotePollSeconds.description: Seconds between reads of logs on other machines over ssh (at least 15)

stallMinutes.title: Stall alert
stallMinutes.description: Minutes without new output before a running log counts as stalled; 0 turns stall alerts off

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Also send each alert through Claude Code's notification channel (your terminal's notification or bell), besides the toast

reuseSsh.title: Reuse ssh connections
reuseSsh.description: Keep one ssh connection per host open for two minutes (ControlMaster, socket under ~/.ssh) so repeated reads reuse it; turn off for hosts where multiplexing misbehaves
